scope: Independent read-only static review of four C budget/dispatch/network/transport files against sole spec 3.0.2. No code writes, tests, browser or network run. Parser/SSE excluded because owner is editing that separate scope.

findings.title: Guard may authorize a physical write after its total deadline
findings.reason: _guard checks time.monotonic before opening the read transaction, performs source/material/proof/secret checks, then only rechecks abort at line180. PinnedNetworkStream.write awaits this guard then calls writer.write. If the real checks cross the remaining deadline, the guard returns success and the bytes can be written after the total timeout.
findings.prediction: Hold a real owner read/proof seam until the remaining dispatch deadline passes, then release. A counted physical writer must not receive a subsequent HTTP write.
findings.requested_change: Recheck the same monotonic deadline after all awaited/transaction work and immediately before granting the network write seam; preserve the non-atomic SQLite-versus-network boundary.
findings.verification_status: Static code path only; no native/test reproduction performed by reviewer.

findings.title: A newly received valid delta or usage can disappear when the post-read guard rejects
findings.reason: pending.result returns a checked event, then await guard precedes appending channel bytes or accepting reported usage. If revoke/current Policy/deadline rejects at this guard, error-terminal construction only uses the prior answer/refusal/usage variables. The already received valid last event is omitted from private partial output and usage facts.
findings.prediction: Deliver first valid answer/refusal delta or monotonic usage, make the next real guard observe revoke/Policy/deadline, then verify the terminal privately retains the received fact while public delivery is blocked as required.
findings.requested_change: Separate retention of already received checked facts from permission to continue transport or expose events. Keep current Policy checks before outward delivery and never release a second request.
findings.verification_status: Static code path only; no reproduction run by reviewer.

no_other_blocking_found_in_read_scope: Input proof absent by default; explicit trusted model/adapter/input-shape/capacity proof required; complete canonical body is frozen and reverified; output parameter remains mandatory; known cost is estimated and unknown price stays unknown.

Single start is committed before network, original terminal can be recovered without source/secret reread, existing unfinished dispatch is not retransmitted, entered database transactions are not automatically retried.

Network rejects unsupported destinations, resolves before connection and pins one admitted address, verifies peer and TLS host, denies redirects/retries/proxies/unix sockets, retains frozen request bytes.
Producer runs independently of consumer pacing and output delivery has a fresh current Policy check; core completion projection requires a matching persisted terminal.
limits: This does not certify parser/SSE behavior, production proof quality, a real system credential backend, model quality or paid provider behavior.
Root and owner must run targeted counterexamples and update source-bound receipts before closure.
